description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Customer' within the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It manages dashboard display, configuration, and data retrieval related to customers in the admin interface.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing the customer dashboard widget and settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer dashboard widget configuration page, setting up data and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of configuration settings for the customer dashboard widget.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns the customer statistics dashboard HTML fragment.
